title: Store implementation slices in the Blueprint Change
context: Operational issues may be archived or deleted, but Apply commits must retain a durable, reviewable description of each vertical implementation unit.
decision: Adapt ticket decomposition into Change-local JSON implementation slices with stable IDs, dependencies, outcomes, acceptance criteria, verification, and durable statuses.

alternatives.option: Keep implementation tickets only in the operational tracker
alternatives.reason: Commit and Change history would lose its durable execution explanation when operational issues expire.

alternatives.option: Restore Spectra tasks.md as the execution authority
alternatives.reason: That would retain a second complete spec workflow and conflict with the repository-native Blueprint lifecycle.

consequences: Slice JSON is committed with the source and tests that complete it.
Runtime claim, retry, and worker identity remain outside Git.
revisitTriggers: A tracker-neutral durable slice store can provide equivalent Git history and offline Manual Apply.
